data.one_liner: Access Stripe API directly in Flutter with support for SCA/PSD2 and payment intents.
data.what_it_does: Provides a native Dart interface to the Stripe REST API, handling payment intents, setup intents, customer management, and SCA/PSD2 authentication flows via web browsers.
use_when: You need direct access to the Stripe API without wrapping official native Stripe SDKs.
You require full support for SCA/PSD2 authentication flows on iOS, Android, and web.
You want to manage Stripe payment intents and customer sessions.
avoid_when: You want a fully packaged pre-built UI for adding payment methods (consider flutter_stripe instead).
You are using backend-only flows that do not require mobile payment gateway integrations.
strengths: Complete support for SCA, 3DS, 3DS2, and BankID authentication.
Direct REST API access with web support.
Supports Google Pay and Apple Pay through the pay library.
weaknesses: Most UI components and screens have been removed in version 5.0.
Adding payment methods directly through this library may require completing a PCI SAQ-D form.
data.setup_notes: Requires intent filters for deep links in AndroidManifest.xml and URL schemes in Info.plist for SCA return URLs.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: Recommended for adding payment methods to benefit from Stripe's PCI compliance and official bindings.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Adyen as your payment gateway instead of Stripe.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard Apple Pay and Google Pay integration without Stripe-specific SDK logic.
